FACT-1.gloss: Train_alpha travels eighty miles on day_one

FACT-2.gloss: Train_beta travels eighty miles on day_one

FACT-3.gloss: Train_alpha travels one_hundred_fifty miles on day_two

FACT-4.gloss: Train_beta travels one_hundred_fifty miles on day_two

RULE-1.gloss: If a train t travels d1 on day_one and d2 on day_two, and ds is the sum of d1 and d2, then the total distance over two days is ds
RULE-1.formula: ∀t∀d1∀d2∀ds((DistOnDay(t, day_one, d1) ∧ DistOnDay(t, day_two, d2) ∧ Sum(d1, d2, ds)) → TotalDistance(t, ds))

INF-1.gloss: Train_alpha's total distance over two days is two_hundred_thirty, derived from FACT-1, FACT-3, FACT-5 using RULE-1 (Modus Ponens)

INF-2.gloss: Train_beta's total distance over two days is two_hundred_thirty, derived from FACT-2, FACT-4, FACT-5 using RULE-1 (Modus Ponens)
